summary.en: Senior Product Designer, Payments at Stripe — Takao Umehara. The closest evidence: Verizon AI Workflow, Total Wireless, Credit Card Portal, Amazon Shopping on Fire TV and Web3 Wallet. Strongest on end-to-end product UX, leading teams and partners and AI products.
summary.jp: Stripe の Senior Product Designer, Payments に向けた、Takao Umehara の要約。近い実績は AI による UX ワークフローの変革・ショッピングフロー & 価格の簡素化・クレジットカード Web ポータル リデザイン・Fire TV 向け Amazon ショッピング・Web3 カストディアルウォレット。プロダクトの UX 全体・チームと関係者を率いること・AI プロダクトに強い。

highlights.role: Lead Product Designer (Agentic UX & AI Systems)
highlights.line: 16+ one-hour interviews with designers and strategists; transcripts clustered with NotebookLM into a searchable pain map
Six live-coded HTML/CSS/JS prototypes exploring plan comparison, cart architecture and pricing display
Led the discovery audit to find the structural root cause rather than catalog every individual problem
Designed a 10-foot commerce interface where the TV is the stage and the phone is the input device
Designed a white-label custodial wallet that abstracts away blockchain complexity
